title: M2M gate: AgentCore Runtime gets its own PingOne token
lede: The agent on AgentCore Runtime asks AgentCore Identity for a PingOne token (M2M, client_credentials): no human, no browser. The downstream rule checks client_id and act.sub before the API is called. Mock only.

steps.title: Agent asks for a token
steps.what: The agent calls AgentCore Identity with oauth2_flow=M2M: no callback URL, no polling, no pre-registration.

steps.title: AgentCore authenticates to PingOne
steps.what: The credential provider's worker app uses client_credentials. token_endpoint_auth_method must be POST: Basic gets 401 invalid_client.

steps.title: Token carries act.sub
steps.what: The mapping puts the agent id in act as an OBJECT, {"sub": "{{castAgentId}}"}. The text "{}" would break the gate.

steps.title: Agent calls the API
steps.what: The agent presents the token to the downstream API.

steps.title: Claims are flattened
steps.what: The token becomes dotted paths such as act.sub and client_id.

steps.title: Rule decides
steps.what: Required claims client_id and act.sub must equal the registered agent. Anything else is denied.
